build_image_digest: node:22-slim, index digest filled in at build time (see the Dockerfile)
severity_reference: NVD primary CVSS base severity (nvd@nist.gov); scanner-native severities are not stored here
upstream_advisories_source: OSV queries (npm ecosystem), 2026-11-13: minimist 0.0.8 (2 advisories), mkdirp 0.5.1 (none), minimist 1.2.8 (none, control)
independence_note: The key comes from OSV/GitHub advisory data and NVD, not from scanner output. OSV/GHSA data is also upstream of both scanners' databases, so agreement with it is not fully independent evidence.

status_meanings.AFFECTED: scanner SHOULD report it (counts toward recall)
status_meanings.FIXED_BY_BACKPORT: scanner should NOT report it (reporting = false positive)

layout: package.json + package-lock.json only (declared and locked, not installed)
scope: npm packages declared in /app/package-lock.json only. Base-image packages are OUT OF SCOPE for this key; they are counted separately.

entries.reference_note: GitHub advisory severity is also CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1 vector CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).
entries.fix_status: Fixed upstream in minimist 0.2.4 (0.x line) and 1.2.6. Installed 0.0.8 is affected. Because minimist is transitive, the fix means updating the parent that pulls it in.
entries.dispute_basis: Lockfile-only image: the package is declared and locked in package-lock.json but NOT installed. A scanner that reports it (declared dependency) and one that does not (nothing installed) are both defensible, so this is recorded as behavior and counted separately, not as a miss.

entries.reference_note: GitHub advisory severity is MODERATE (CVSS 3.1 vector CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L).
entries.fix_status: Fixed upstream in minimist 0.2.1 (0.x line) and 1.2.3. Installed 0.0.8 is affected.
entries.dispute_basis: Lockfile-only image: the package is declared and locked in package-lock.json but NOT installed. A scanner that reports it (declared dependency) and one that does not (nothing installed) are both defensible, so this is recorded as behavior and counted separately, not as a miss.

clean_controls: mkdirp 0.5.1 has no advisories (OSV, 2026-11-13); any finding on mkdirp is a false positive and is checked manually.

predictions.status: HYPOTHESES recorded before building or scanning; not part of the answer key. LOW confidence throughout.
predictions.detection: Trivy reports both minimist advisories (it reads package-lock.json). Grype reports neither (image scans use installed-package metadata, and nothing is installed). Low confidence on both halves.
predictions.if_this_holds: Native gates split: Trivy BLOCK on P1, P2 and P3, Grype PASS on all three. That would be a verdict split caused by a tool design choice, recorded as behavior (DISPUTED), not as a miss.
predictions.how_scored: Reported-or-not is counted separately for DISPUTED entries; neither tool is penalized.
